author: TeIq
content: Implemented. queue.rs adds checkboxes per row + bulk-action toolbar (hidden until 1+ selected). Toolbar offers [Acknowledge all] / [Escalate all] / [Clear selection]; the spawn_bulk helper groups selected (SubjectId, IncidentId) pairs by incident_id and issues one POST per incident to /api/bulk-actions. Combined succeeded/failed counts are summed and rendered inline. Stop-propagation on checkbox click prevents accidental focus shifts. Frontend client trait grows bulk_action method; DTOs added (BulkSubmitAction / BulkActionOutcome / BulkActionFailure). 158 lib tests + styles_coverage + styles_tokens pass; clippy -D warnings clean.
